logp.method_description: The log P value for 1–5 and Cu(2,2′;6′,2′′-terpyridine)Cl2 was determined using the shake-flask method and UV-Vis spectroscopy. The 1-octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with water. A DMSO solution of 1–5 or Cu(2,2′;6′,2′′-terpyridine)Cl2 (10 μL, 10 mM) was incubated with 1-octanol (495 μL) and H2O (495 μL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 24 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and the 1–5 or Cu(2,2′;6′,2′′-terpyridine)Cl2 content in each phase was determined by UV-vis spectroscopy. The reported log P values are the average of three independent experiments (n = 3).
